content:
**Survey Camp Alpha** is a location in the Cranberry Bog region of Appalachia. It is one of several camps set up throughout the region by the Appalachian Brotherhood of Steel.

A small barricaded campsite, comprised of an Automated Surface to Air Missile, two tents and a tarp-covered shelter with a Power Armor Station. A Cooking Station is located in the center of the camp, as is Brotherhood Transponder AZ-13. Fissure Site Alpha can be found nearby, a short distance to the west.

- Potential Vault-Tec Bobblehead - In the center tent, on a crate in the back.
- Potential Magazine - Near the northwest tent, on a small green table.
- Power Armor Chassis with T-series power armor pieces - Under the awning.
- Potential power armor mod plan - On a crate to the left of a large toolbox.
- Stealth Boy - Behind the aforementioned large toolbox.

Survey camp Alpha appears in *Fallout 76*.
